The Joy Group

By: Busisiwe Gumede | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
From the small township of Hammersdale, in Sterkspruit to performing on the international stage, accapella singing group The Joy has become infamous for its ability to transcend genre and continents t

Unique Selling Point:
The five kids were members of a school choir who would arrive early and sing before their practice sessions. They started recording these sessions and were surprised by how many South Africans enjoyed their singing. In just two years, they were collaborating with big names like Madonna, playing Jools Holland and performing at the Commonwealth Games. That was only the beginning; they’ve since caught the attention of artists like Alicia Keys, Sam Smith and Jennifer Hudson who are all queuing up to collaborate with the boys.



Summary:
Each member has a story to tell about how they were struggling and had to overcome personal adversity to get to where they are. Like the group leader who at some point dropped out of school because of no food at home. Another member, Shadrack, had lost all hope after losing both parents and now had to provide for a child headed home. These are real stories and challenges that young people face. This piece aims to celebrate this young group by being in their world. They have granted us access to their school, homes and community.


Extra Budget Items:
Travel budget. Air tickets to Durban.

Press Release:


The Joy
It began as little more than a group of young boys, all belonging to the school choir, singing melodies together to pass time. But when the boys from Hammarsdale in Sterkspruit started recording their sessions and sharing them on social media, thousands of South Africans began to take note. Then within three years, some of the world’s biggest musicians were queuing up to share the stage with the newly formed acapella singing sensation The Joy. Now, they’re a bona fide international act, but their musical roots remain firmly in South Africa.
Producer: Busisiwe Gumede-Chizhanje | Presenter: Masa Kekana

Script:


VO – With more than 100 000 people ATTENDING each night and millions more streaming online from around the world, Coachella is the biggest music festival in the US
BREATHER
VO – On stage, multi-award winning rapper, Doja Cat,
BREATHER
VO – Doja Cat is SUPPORTED BY ISIZULU HARMONIES FROM THIS South African group
THE JOY

23:08 - It was a dream come true for me.


225:00 We were all dressed in white. and it felt like the coming of Jesus and we’re his angels.
VO – Many acts wait their whole careers to make it onto the Coachella lineup... but acappella sensations, The Joy, went from KwaZulu-Natal to the world stage in only a few years… Social media popularity ignited Doja Cat's interest in their music.
BREATHER – transition to Masa
VO – Back home, at the Johannesburg Civic Theatre, the group is still on a Coachella high as they prepare to wow local fans with new music.
BREATHER
LINK - “Acappella” – from the Italian phrase “in the style of the church”, a reference to simplicity and an entrancing quality – a perfect description not just for the popular genre of music but also, The Joy, a captivating quintet from KZN, whose mesmerising harmonies are almost spiritual in nature.
BREATHER
VO – Performed without any instruments, acappella is AS popular in KwaZulu-Natal as 'isicathamiya' – which means 'tread lightly', referring to the subtle footwork associated with the genre.
BREATHER – upsound ladysmith Black Mambazo
VO – Isicathamiya was made a global phenomenon by Grammy-award winning Ladysmith Black Mambazo in the seventies - but its storytelling origins goes back decades before that.
BREATHE – Sam and Masa listening to The Joy
SAM MATHE – MUSIC JOURNALIST

Wow, amazing!


04:57 - Well my first impression when I listen to them is that they take me back in time.


12:42 - ... it's a very rich oral tradition and when they package it in musical format you can hear the cultural references and history.


05:14 - ... This is what was called vocal harmony groups.


05:04 - … These were groups that came in the 40s and 50s.

05:26 - You mainly have four or five guys singing in harmony with a lead or in most cases a tenor.
VO – SAM Mathe, MUSIC JOURNALIST AND HISTORIAN, says the genre as it is known today, takes isiZulu tradition, right into our cities.
SAM MATHE – MUSIC JOURNALIST


29:54 - ... They had events in places like Kwa Mai Mai and various hostels. At the time they were called compounds,


30:11 - men's residence. Migrant workers were based there. On weekends, for entertainment, they would have competitions.
VO - Like Ladysmith Black Mambazo, The Joy has taken the culture beyond local urban areas and onto the world stage.
BREATHER
The Joy comprises of childhood friends Melokuhle Mkhungo, Ntokozo Magcaba, Sanele Ngcobo, Phelelani Ndlovu…and lead singer Sanele Hlophe, who'd only heard Doja Cat's music on the radio but didn't know how big of a star she was.
SANELE HLOPHE – THE JOY


T2 - 11:45 - I took notice only after they said this was the person who wanted to work with us. When they played her song, I thought ‘this is the lady that is calling for us?’ - 11:53

T2 - 11:54 - That’s when I saw that we aren’t just a small group. - 11:59
BREATHER
VO –Dr Sipho Sithole – an acclaimed arts and culture practitioner who’s managed the country's top acappella musicians – watched The Joy perform at Coachella.
DR SIPHO SITHOLE – ARTS AND CULTURE PRACTITIONER


16:15 - ... I love the fact that they have managed to embrace this oral tradition that has always been seen to be music of old people, music of people who live in the hostels, music of people who live in the margins of society, and they have now taken it and said... 16:41 - ‘You are doing something that we like, but we're going to show you that we can make it more youthful and more mainstream.’ So it's a crossover. And I think they are doing well. - 16:52
VO – But the journey to Coachella started years ago, when the group members were JUST boys herding cattle.
MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY


T2 - 03:57 – We grew up watching our older brothers perform isicathamiya and shiya mina.


SANELE NGCOBO – THE JOY


T2 - 04:52 - … My singing started when I lived with my grandfather in the village called Mid Illovo. That’s when I discovered that I can sing especially when I met my brothers at school.


PHELELANI NDLOVU


T2 - 04:45 – We’re talented musicians in my family. (Chuckling by other members) - 04:48
VO – The boys have always known there was something special about their music DESPITE BEING DISCOURAGED BY OTHERS.
MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY


T2 - 02:02 - There were talks from our other friends, saying “are you real men? We’re all playing soccer, you are singing with girls at school.” - 02:10
VO –But the elders didn't see music as much of a career.
MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY


T2 - 12:26 - ... Like all parents who want their child to become a doctor, etc. - 12:36

MASA - 13:21 - How long did it take for you to convince your parents that music is something that you love? - 13:29

MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY

T2 - 13:30 - It took a long time. It took us entering a competition called Ethekwini Municipality talent show, where we took position number one with a price of R25, 000. Our first competition. - 13:43


NTOKOZO MAGCABA – THE JOY


T2 - 14:22 - I had never been that happy because I could take the cheque home and show it to my strict mother. She doesn't play around. - 14:28 (group laughs) 14:32 - My mother is very strict. It was only when she saw the money that she accepted that what we were doing was worthwhile. (laughing) - 14:38
VO – Winning the competition fueled the boys' ambition.
MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY

T2 - 15:31 - That’s when we started taking this seriously and started our own social media pages where we would post our music trying to find a bigger opportunity for our talent to be seen globally.
15:47
VO - And just like that their harmonies went viral.
BREATHER – Social media posts over music of The Joy, from famous people too.
LINK - … acappella requires precision, talent and an unmatched vocal range. The Joy has it all! Their voices complement each other perfectly, creating a rich and full sound that inspires fans worldwide.
VO A keen-eyed UK producer changed the trajectory of their lives forever. In 2020,producer Two Inch Punch, flew from the UK to meet the group and record a couple of songs to share with an overseas-based record label.

- get pic from Two Inch Punch Instagram, he's big on the socials
MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY

T3 - 01:02 - He left for the UK with our recordings and then lockdown happened. Covid arrived. He left saying we should get our passports in order. - 01:19

T3 - 01:20 - We got our passports in order and about a week later the world ‘closed.’
VO – The Joy finally made it to the UK last year to record their debut album. Since then, they have wowed crowds inEUROPE... and attracted the attention of global superstars LIKE acclaimed vocalist and talk show host, Jennifer Hudson. jjj
BREATHER - Cue cellphone video of Jenifer Hudson singing and having fun with them in make up room.
MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY


That was the best best show ever!


LINK - ...so what will it take to ensure the longevity of their craft and relationship?



DR SIPHO SITHOLE – ARTS AND CULTURE PRACTITIONER

20:01 - The fact that young people are so into this music now, at the time when Amapiano is rising, actually then shows that they have longevity.


MASA – 17:52 - … what advice would you give to a group like The Joy considering what you've done to mould other successful acapella groups? - 18:02


??? - Stay away from illegal substances. - 18:43


??? - The money that you make now, you might not make it next year. - 18:52


19:02 - So save the money.


DR SIPHO SITHOLE – ARTS AND CULTURE PRACTITIONER

23:40 - Your songwriting. What do you write about?

??? - I think the creativity that they have, even on stage, the flexibility in how they approach their music, and being able to make it more relatable, making it relatable – 20:00


25:42 - ... it's very organic and it's very it comes from a deep inspiration that one will never understand.
VO -Now, that they’re on the global stage, their bond is stronger than ever.
MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY

T3 - 10:20 - ... we know how to sit down, have a meeting and talk about what we like and dislike and lets find a way for it not to happen again moving forward. - 10:27
SAM MATHE – MUSIC JOURNALIST


13:39 - … I see Joy as a group if they can keep it together as a group that can endure for the next few decades because they have what it takes
VO – The Joy plans to continue flying the South African flag high on the global stage. MUSICAL INTERLUDE 4 SECONDS
NTOKOZO MAGCABA – THE JOY

T2 - 31:46 - We’re currently recording with some big international artists but we can't reveal who they are just yet. - 31:50

MELOKUHLE MKHUNGO – THE JOY

32:16 - We’re also going to bring back a Grammy. (all laugh) - 32:19
